clarifications.decision_time: For a 100ms bin indexed i, the completed decision time is the end of bin i.
clarifications.entry_latency: A 100ms latency makes the first eligible quote update one whose local_timestamp is at or after the end of bin i+1; in zero-based bins this is bin i+2 or later.
clarifications.actual_entry_quote: Use the first valid quote update after the latency boundary, not the last quote carried to an arbitrary grid point.
clarifications.spread_for_grid_and_target_deduction: Use the actual entry quote log spread. Long target exit is target mid minus half that log spread; short target exit is target mid plus half that log spread.
clarifications.quote_intensity_baseline: For each horizon, sample completed quote-update counts at one-second boundaries and take the prior 900-boundary positive-window median, excluding the current shock window.
clarifications.raw_24bp_diagnostic: Counts prior-model-valid same-direction events whose conservative executable gap from the actual post-latency entry quote is at least 24bp before common-score, queue-support, intensity, underreaction, follower-queue and spread-grid thresholds.
clarifications.artifact_boundary: Raw downloaded gzip files remain runner-temporary. SHA manifests, causal aggregates, event rows, gate output and logs are uploaded.
